request: Rank the 4 best Dodge Challenger generations overall across the full production run. Use 4 different generations when available, with one representative version from each generation. If the model has fewer than 4 true generations, use the most important era-defining versions across its history.
title: BEST DODGE CHALLENGER GENERATIONS RANKED
close_narration: So, what’s your pick—the time-bending T/A or the beastly Hellcat?
order_rationale: Ranked by weighted enthusiast desirability, driving engagement, historical significance, performance, collectibility, and value—not chronology.

entries.name: Challenger T/A
entries.label: TRANS AM SPECIAL
entries.one_line_fact: Starting our Dodge Challenger countdown, the 1970 T/A isn’t just a car—it’s a time machine. With side exhausts and racing badges, it roared into Trans Am racing for $4,260, and you’d pay $32,000 to relive it today.
entries.ranking_case: Sought after for its racing pedigree and distinctive design, offering unique appeal for collectors.

entries.name: First Gen R/T
entries.label: CLASSIC ICON

entries.ranking_case: The original Challenger R/T set the muscle car standard with its iconic Hemi engine and classic design.
